svg.text: 12. Who is faster: the EUVD or the KEV catalogues?
EUVD record datePublished against exploitedSince (the earliest KEV date), for every exploited entry flagged since October 2024 (586 entries), by month of flagging.
Months with fewer than 5 entries are left out.

g.text: days from EUVD record to first KEV listing (log scale)

svg.text: Top: per month, how many entries were in the EUVD first, on the same day, or flagged by a KEV catalogue first; the EUVD was first for 79%. Bottom:
the gap in days, bars for the median and hollow dots for the mean. Over the period the median is 16.5 days and the mean 484: a few entries waited
years, which pulls the mean up, so the median is the fairer "average". Since the go-live (53 entries) the median is 10 and the mean 329.
Limits: The gap runs from the EUVD record to the first KEV listing: how long an entry waited in the EUVD before being flagged, not which source knew first, since a
vulnerability may have been public elsewhere earlier. A change in the gap is an observation; the chart cannot say why it changed.
